arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Jones cited the opposing sides' brief to argue that secondary liability contradicts the direct assessment requirement.
Mr. Haberbush addressed the historical context of imposing derivative liability on partnership members.
Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the argument by stating the case was submitted.
